context.note: Detail-page edit form identity; appended after the bold 'projects', same shape as tui.projects.new_project. Keep the leading middot and space.
Binding for `e` on the project detail page; opens the prefilled edit form. Not painted in the hint row (hints use the shorter hint_ keys).
Binding for `a` on the detail page; opens the add-milestone prompt.
Binding for `x` on the detail page; asks the inline y/n confirm before removing the selected milestone.
Tab inside the add-milestone prompt; moves between its two fields.
Enter inside the add-milestone prompt; submits it.
Escape inside the add-milestone prompt; closes it without writing.
Detail footer hint after the `e` key. Lowercase; the painter supplies the leading space and the key glyph.
Detail footer hint after the `a` key. Lowercase.
Detail footer hint after the `x` key; armed only while a milestone row is selected. Lowercase.
Add-milestone prompt footer hint after `tab`. Lowercase.
Add-milestone prompt footer hint after `enter`. Lowercase.
Escape label in the add-milestone prompt footer. Lowercase.

en: the reference handle — changing it renames the key
ur: حوالے کا ہینڈل — اسے بدلنے سے کلید کا نام بدلے گا

context.note: Under the key field in EDIT mode only. Create mode keeps tui.projects' follows-the-title hint. Single line; may clip at narrow widths.

en: an estimate cannot be cleared — enter a number or restore the old one
ur: تخمینہ صاف نہیں کیا جا سکتا — عدد درج کریں یا پرانا بحال کریں

context.note: Under the estimate field when the reader clears it: the store has no clear state for an estimate (ProjectEdit.estimate None means untouched). Must name the two ways forward.
Under the estimate field when the text is not a number; matches the store's own sentence for the same case.

en: estimate must be greater than 0 and at most {maximum}
ur: تخمینہ 0 سے بڑا اور زیادہ سے زیادہ {maximum} ہو

context.note: Under the estimate field when the number is outside the store's bound. {maximum} is the cap the store enforces (1000).

en: the target date is before the start date
ur: ہدف کی تاریخ آغاز کی تاریخ سے پہلے کی ہے

context.note: Under the target date when it precedes the start date. Mirrors the create form's rule in this namespace so the edit form does not reach into a pinned namespace.

en: the key is required — it is the reference handle
ur: کلید ضروری ہے — یہی حوالے کا ہینڈل ہے

context.note: Under the key field when it is emptied. Same meaning as the create form's sentence; the edit form has no auto-slug, so there is no example to give.

en: ''{name}'' is no longer in the store — the edit was not saved
ur: اسٹور میں ''{name}'' اب موجود نہیں — ترمیم محفوظ نہیں ہوئی

context.note: Footer notice when the project vanished between opening the edit form and saving. {name} is the project's display name.

en: ''{name}'' is no longer in the store — the milestone was not changed
ur: اسٹور میں ''{name}'' اب موجود نہیں — سنگ میل نہیں بدلا

context.note: Footer notice when the project vanished during an add/remove milestone write. {name} is the project's display name.

ur: محفوظ کرنے کے لیے کوئی تبدیلی نہیں

context.note: Form footer after ctrl+s with nothing changed: no write happened. Short — the footer is one row.
Detail footer after an edit landed. Short; the page recomposes from the store around it.

en: remove milestone ''{name}''? · y remove · n keep
ur: سنگ میل ''{name}'' ہٹائیں؟ · y ہٹائیں · n رکھیں

context.note: Pinned one-line question before removing a milestone. Keep `y` and `n` literal: they are the keys. {name} is the milestone name.

en: put the cursor on a milestone row to remove
ur: ہٹانے کے لیے کرسر سنگ میل کی قطار پر رکھیں

context.note: Footer notice when `x` is pressed with a non-milestone row selected; names the arrow keys.
Detail footer after a milestone was removed. {name} is the milestone name.
Detail footer after a NEW milestone was added. {name} is the milestone name.
Detail footer when `a` named a milestone that already existed: the store's add-or-update op updated it instead. {name} is the milestone name.

ur: سنگ میل ''{name}'' پہلے سے بالکل ایسا ہی تھا

context.note: Detail footer when `a` echoed an existing milestone exactly: the store reports a truthful no-change. {name} is the milestone name.
Appended to the detail title while the add-milestone prompt is up. Keep the leading middot and space, like tui.projects.new_project.
Label over the prompt's name input. Lowercase, one line.

en: a name that exists updates it
ur: موجودہ نام سے وہی سنگ میل اپ ڈیٹ ہوگا

context.note: States the store's add-or-update rule so a duplicate name does not surprise. One line.

ur: سنگ میل کا نام ضروری ہے

context.note: Under the name input when it is empty. One line.
Label over the prompt's optional target-date input. Lowercase.
Names the optional format. Keep YYYY-MM-DD literal: it is the accepted spelling.
